summary.name: Leonardo.Ai
summary.one_liner: Leonardo.Ai is a generative AI platform for creating images, art, and video, with a Teams offering aimed at marketing and design leaders.
summary.what_it_does: The page showcases AI-generated images across many styles, including product photography, fashion editorial portraits, 3D and anime-style illustrations, landscapes, and still lifes, each produced from a text prompt. It describes a sketch-and-prompt workflow for exploring creative directions and refining concept art. It also promotes a Teams product for scaling campaigns and content production, including AI-powered video production. Directory listings describe it as offering fine-tuned models and a suite of creative tools for game assets and artistic visuals, and mention Veo 3 and Phoenix models. The page itself does not list specific features or pricing details beyond these claims.
notable: Fine-tuned models and creative suite for game assets and concept art
Teams offering for marketing and design leaders to scale content and video production
Includes Veo 3 and Phoenix models according to a directory listing
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; one directory lists it as free but the page itself does not confirm this
Page is mostly marketing and gallery examples with few concrete feature details
